properties.evidence: MITIGATES rather than INVALIDATES, and the distinction is the point. This change adds the linker to the guard and corrects its header, so the known gap is closed — but the guard's membership is still a hand-maintained list, so the cause it names is still live and the next write path added under a different call name will be outside it again. Reading this as a fix would be the 'the error is gone, so it's fixed' failure.
